about_the_game:
Demo Coming Soon!

We're still simmering the broth for our playable demo. We aim to release it within the next couple of weeks, showcasing our initial concept and vision that we plan to build upon based on your feedback. Make sure to wishlist our game and check back on our Steam page for an announcement when the demo becomes available!


Just a taste

This demo is an early taste of whats to come. We are working hard building the best ramen business and want you to get a preview. 

Prepare ramen, make broth, fry some chachu and boil noodles to perfection. Get a glimpse of running a ramen shop for one day.

The main focus this time around is cooking, serving, decorating and customizing. 

Let us cook

We are still working hard on this experience, so please join our discord and follow our social channels! We want to hear what you think and discuss everything from features to gameplay, let’s cook up something great!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or equivalent, 2.3 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: This game puts you in the shoes of a new restaurant owner. Even if the restaurant you have isn’t in the best shape to begin with, and the alley it’s located in have seen better days, we trust you to transform it to something truly special. Here is your chance to get a sneak peek of our ramen-world!
